value.rationale: In an explicitly motivated two-observer memory setting, the single path identifies two hidden independent copying reliabilities up to permutation. At fixed mean fidelity the ballistic threshold and zero-step fraction stay fixed, whereas speed rises strictly with channel heterogeneity: a structural and measurable distinction, not a routine numerical gain.
